The TWAP baseline is anchored at the lifetime time‑weighted average of $1,700, with the current price 4 % below this level, signalling a mild undervaluation. The regression fair‑value band sets a theoretical floor at $832 (a 50 % correction from the current price) and a ceiling at $1,300, while a more optimistic euphoria target rises to $10,000 per the regression model. Residual zones indicate that the asset is currently undervalued relative to its long‑term TWAP but remains within a moderate risk envelope.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
Machine‑learning forecasts project a bottom near $1,200 if the next 10 weeks remain bearish but non‑panicky, and a short‑term non‑euphoria peak of $2,400 within the same window. The maximum despair floor of $832 represents a worst‑case scenario, while the current price’s proximity to the $1,300 floor underscores a potential short‑term bottom.
